prompt: Write the build/test guide for this repo.

message_includes: probe unavailable: the guide is unverified, so the floor will not use it for exclusion

rationale: vitest has a JUnit reporter whose ids round-trip with `vitest list`, so the guide is junit. Two limits must be reported, not hidden: vitest rejects a repeated name pattern, so deselect cannot exclude two ids; and its JUnit lists the tests a name filter left out as <skipped/> testcases, which core's reader (#1066 @ df67a95) counts, so the alone probe fails.
